capabilities: punch in and out of activities with two clicks from a category grid
back-fill or edit missed segments on a 24-hour timeline
generate live daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by category
view a monthly heatmap of recorded hours per day
customize categories and keywords, with undo for the latest punch
extras: Bilingual README (English and Chinese) with a documented one-line-per-segment Markdown file format; includes a tip that Obsidian Sync does not sync community plugins by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log what you were doing as timed segments and see daily, weekly, or monthly breakdowns.
summary: Time tracker that records activities with a two-click punch-in, back-fills missed segments on a 24-hour timeline, and stores everything as Markdown.
